name: workflow-tools
description: Codex planning, explanation, and explicit toolbox shipping skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, explain, and safely ship toolbox changes.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Tools packages Explain Clearly for concise explanations, Deep Planning for adversarial Plan Mode critique, and Ship Toolbox for explicit validation, commit, push, CI, and local marketplace refresh workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $explain-clearly to explain this with a simple mental model and concrete example.
Use $deep-planning to critique this plan before implementation.
Use $ship-toolbox to validate, commit, push, refresh, and verify the current toolbox changes.
Review this Plan Mode request for assumptions, risks, and routing.
